verdict.rationale: Vercel AI Gateway gives one endpoint to call hundreds of models via the AI SDK, any OpenAI-compatible SDK, or cURL. It routes across providers with automatic fallbacks, budgets, and usage monitoring, so the builder never provisions GPUs or plans capacity. Fluid compute adds concurrency scaling for AI workloads. Missing for 10: evidence that inference is served or routed globally at the edge (no regions or latency claims), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
